title: An animation studio that renders at night
summary: A Guadalajara studio renders a short film overnight on 200 VMs that read the same scenes. The artists work from their office and no scene can be lost.

requirements.1: {{s1}} holds the project folder that hundreds of Linux servers mount at the same time over NFS, available in both zones.
requirements.2: {{s2}} keeps last night's version of the project folder, so a scene someone deletes by mistake can be recovered.
requirements.3: {{s3}} stores the finished frames for years; they are read over HTTP and survive the loss of an entire zone.
requirements.4: {{s4}} provides the render nodes: they can shut down with seconds or minutes of notice because the job resumes, and the lowest price with no commitment matters.
requirements.5: {{s5}} joins the office to the cloud network today, encrypted, over the internet it already has.
requirements.6: The artists work at the studio office in Guadalajara and upload their scenes from there.

s1.explanation: Amazon EFS is Regional: it has a mount target in each zone and many NFS clients use it at the same time. EBS Multi-Attach only works with io1 and io2 and up to 16 instances in the same zone.
s1.hint_cue: mount at the same time over NFS

s2.explanation: AWS Backup backs up the file system every day with its default plan and allows an item-level restore, so only the deleted folder comes back. Replication only keeps the copy synchronized with the source.

s3.explanation: S3 Standard stores objects across at least three zones and is designed to keep them even if an entire zone is lost. S3 One Zone-IA stores them in a single zone.
s3.hint_cue: survive the loss of an entire zone

s4.explanation: A Spot Instance uses spare EC2 capacity for less than the On-Demand price and gets a notice two minutes before EC2 interrupts it. Savings Plans lowers the price only in exchange for committing to usage for one or three years.

s5.explanation: Site-to-Site VPN connects the office network to the VPC through two encrypted IPsec tunnels, and a site-to-site VPN can run over the internet. Direct Connect uses a dedicated fiber cable and bypasses internet service providers.
s5.hint_cue: over the internet it already has

aws-ebs.s1: An EBS volume with Multi-Attach connects to at most 16 instances in the same zone, and common file systems cannot handle several servers at once.
aws-ebs.s3: An EBS volume attaches to instances in a single zone; it does not serve the frames over HTTP or survive the loss of that zone.

aws-efs-replication.s2: Replication keeps the destination copy synchronized with the source, so it reflects the folder's current state, not last night's version.
aws-efs-replication.s1: Replication copies a file system that already exists; on its own it is not the folder the servers mount.

aws-s3-one-zone-ia.s3: S3 One Zone-IA stores objects in a single Availability Zone, so it is not designed to survive the loss of that zone.

aws-savings-plans.s4: Savings Plans lowers the price in exchange for committing to hourly usage for one or three years, and the requirement asks for no commitment.

aws-direct-connect.s5: Direct Connect links the network to a Direct Connect location over an Ethernet fiber cable and bypasses internet service providers: it does not use the internet the office already has.
